comment: Ermac parity configuration: the defaults applied to every scenario, and the fixtures (real ids harvested from the OLD side, used as {name} in routes). The scenarios are in parity/scenarios.json, a list of scenario objects; see parity/README.md ("Adding a parity test").

Every scenario runs on the OLD and the NEW bundle under identical, deterministic conditions; all layers (api, ext, dom, probes, steps, errors, pixels) must agree. A scenario is a route + optional steps + optional probes.
boot: virtual ms after page load, before the first step
step_after: virtual ms after each step (unless the step sets after)
settle: virtual ms after the last step, before the capture
probe: evaluated in EVERY scenario (cheap, broad UX invariants)
ignore_attributes: the accessibility markup (src_js/core/a11y.js) is stripped before old vs new comparisons; the a11y scenarios assert it on the NEW side
